answer: Every identity posts a 70-credit bond and files one nectar batch on a trellis registry grouping identities by shared funding within three hops. The k-th member posts 70+25(k-1); 1,000 fakes in one cluster post 12,557,500. Each batch needs two echo votes from lottery peers outside it, each staking 10 credits. A missing batch, reused hash, or false echo vote burns that bond and the voter stake. A rented-cluster ring fails: 1,000 sources cost more than the bonds saved, and voters cannot be picked. One honest identity pays 70 plus a 34 fee once and recovers its bond on two honest echo votes.
